learningGoals: Calculate amounts per unit and shares; reverse share to count.
Calculate absolute and relative changes with the old value as denominator.
Use increase/decrease factors to obtain a new value.
Calculate and interpret indices, compare non-100 indices and reverse index to amount.
Distinguish percentage points, index points and percent change; separate share and group-size effects.
